query:
UPDATE users
            SET failed_login_attempts = failed_login_attempts + 1,
                locked_until = CASE
                    WHEN failed_login_attempts + 1 >= $2 THEN
                        $3::timestamptz
                            + make_interval(secs => $4::float8 * power(2, LEAST(failed_login_attempts + 1 - $2, 5)))
                    ELSE locked_until
                END
            WHERE id = $1
